translation: The coming and going of qi and blood, up and down, are all within it; the channels and vessels are all within it; and the accumulation arises within it. Once it is rubbed and dispersed, it does not enter the viscera and bowels but returns to the qi aspect, retreats through the original channels to the navel, reaches the stomach, descends into the skin and membranes of the large and small intestines, and comes out through the fart orifice and the essence orifice. How do I know this? Every time I rub the jaw, I must release qi, and I know it also from turbid strangury and bloody stool.
